description: On-demand MCP tool-selection eval suite for @openthrottle/openthrottle-mcp: cases, graders, baselines, the Anthropic and agent-CLI selectors, and the sandboxed MCP the CLIs attach to.
name: @openthrottle/openthrottle-mcp-evals

metadata.description: On-demand MCP tool-selection eval: runs every case in src/tool-selection/data/data.cases.ts against the Claude Messages API (--driver api, the default; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; spends tokens) or through agent CLIs (--driver claude,codex; spends subscription usage) with a sandboxed MCP attached in place of the real server, and compares with the same driver+model baseline in src/tool-selection/baselines/. Runs on the @openthrottle/agentic-evals core. Flags after `--`: --driver, --model, --effort, --trials, --case <id|area,...>, --tolerance, --concurrency (api only; CLI runs are sequential), --auth-mode (CLI), --timeout-ms (CLI), --write-baseline. Exits 1 on a regression, 3 if a CLI reached a server other than the sandbox. Never wired into CI or check:local — only its grader unit tests run there, through `test`.
